:::{#def-lp-function-space}
#### $\mathcal{L}^p$ space ($\mathcal{L}^p(S, \salg, \measure)$)

Let $(S, \salg, \measure)$ be a [measure space](#def-measure-space),
and let $p \ge 1$ be a real number.
The **$\mathcal{L}^p$ space** $\mathcal{L}^p(S, \salg, \measure)$
is the set of all [measurable functions](#def-measurable-function) $f : S \to \reals$
whose [$L^p$ norm](#def-lp-norm) is finite: $\norm{f}_p < \infty$.

:::
